entities.summary: Eudoxia Fyodorovna Lopukhina was the tsaritsa of all Russia from 1689 to 1698 as the first wife of Peter I. She was the last ethnic Russian and non-foreign wife of a Russian monarch. She was the mother of Tsarevich Alexei Petrovich and the paternal grandmother of Peter II of Russia.
